lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately eight vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a structured grid-like pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast grid nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of smaller high-luminance blobs is visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-luminance feature is attached ventrally near the posterior insertion point of the left pectoral fin, consistent with a commensal organism.
